notes.title: Interface Uplift Changes - Batch I | September 24th
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/d807cd374a31db47d03d43054a3eabb226cf3448.png

The first batch of Interface Uplift hits this week - Smarter cannonballs, better alerts, and easier world hopping for activities.
[hr][/hr]
Changelog September 24th

[expand type=show more]

Interface Uplift Changes
	You can now set a custom amount of cannonballs to load into your Dwarven multicannon with a new 'Load-X' option, helping you avoid waste while grinding. This value can be customised in the settings menu.	When your prayer is drained at Barrows, a chat message will now appear alongside the floating face effect to make it clearer what’s happening.	Chugging barrels can now pull potions directly from both your bank and potion storage when loading, with a new bank setting to control this behaviour.	Added a 'Bank all' button to the Theatre of Blood death chest.	Added a toggleable setting to toggle a warning when depositing high-value seeds into a birdhouse on Fossil Island.	The Set Effects menu now shows bonuses from each piece of an outfit, as well as the full set bonus.	Converted the Grouping tab's 'Suggested world' section into a button so that players can easily hop to the suggested world for a given activity.  
Other Changes
 Fire and Infernal capes will now keep their fiery textures when teleporting, instead of briefly swapping to a static version. Fixed the Slayer cape perk so players can now get back-to-back Zuk tasks as intended. Fixed some blocked ground near Taverley that was stopping players from walking through. The four bandana eyepatches can now be used for a clue that requires a bandana. Bandana eyepatches once again have the correct colour inventory icon. The ring of stone, and similar items, no longer break you out of being tethered to scenery at Tempoross. The new icon that denotes mobile users is now automatically hidden in the Bounty Hunter lobby area.

PvP Rota

PSA: We’re aware that the Bounty Hunter worlds did not rotate as expected this week. Apologies for the mix-up! They will revert to their correct rotation in next week’s update, switching over to the expected Rotation B.

The PvP rota has moved to Period A:
  539 - (US) - PvP World  318 - (UK) - Bounty Hunter World  548 - (Germany) - High-Risk PvP World  577 - (US) - Free-to-Play PvP World  559 - (UK) - LMS Competitive
World 390 (AUS) for LMS Competitive has been activated with this rota.

World 569 (AUS) for Bounty Hunter has been activated with this rota.

The PvP Arena is using '1 Def Pure' loadouts in Ranked Duels and Tournaments this week.
[/expand]
[hr][/hr]
Interface Uplift Changes

This week brings in the first batch of changes from our Interface Uplift blog. Let's take a look!

Chugging Barrel Improvements

Tired of jumping back and forth between your Bank and Potion Storage just to top up your Chugging Barrel? We hear you. Now, when you hit the 'Load' button, your barrel can snatch potions from both your Bank and Potion Storage at the same time - no interface gymnastics required.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/3255d028ec544d23ffbbc45cb23b9f6099d987f8.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

There’s even a new bank setting so you can decide whether your barrel raids both storages or just the one you’ve got open. To keep things crystal clear, chat messages will tell you exactly how many doses came from each spot - so more potions, less clicking!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/e708cc525519fa2ecb8b515d1b7de370dfbe7b53.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Multi Cannon

Ever wish you could load your Dwarven Multicannon with just the right number of cannonballs without wasting a single one? Now you can! The new 'Load-X' option lets you pick exactly how many cannonballs to feed your cannon, so you can go full-on siege mode, or just tickle a few mobs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/8fc93d6ea3b2c02ffd724201f625ad9e8e586289.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Want to change your default load? No problem - the amount can be customised right in the settings menu. Boom.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/6a78ae8cc0d986bd74f40ac0cf6f01f040a36e7f.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Barrows Prayer

Nothing ruins a Barrows run faster than not noticing your Prayer getting sapped by those spooky brothers. To save you from accidentally running dry, we’ve added a chat message that pops up whenever your Prayer is drained - right alongside the classic floating face effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/9ecba1e063b27a83896a2c86f07fbeca2b37cea1.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Now it’s crystal clear when your Prayer’s taking a hit, so you can react faster and keep that HP from falling.

Bank All Your Shame at ToB

Dying in the Theatre of Blood is never fun, but reclaiming your loot just got a little less soul-crushing. The ToB death chest now has a Bank all button.

Simply unlock your chest, hit the button, and all items will be sent straight to your bank in one click. Perfect for when you want to rage quit with feeling.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/19b52a546037239e76dec0f31681a325755c018c.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Birdhouse Seed Warning

Accidentally chucking high-value seeds into your Fossil Island birdhouses? Ouch. To save your GP from flying away, we’ve added a toggleable warning when depositing seeds above a value you choose. Head into the settings menu to turn the warning on and set your personal threshold.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/d0fd4036c8fac7fde56e3a61996b85bcec8c4ec7.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

When you try to plonk in a pricey seed, a friendly chat message will pop up, making sure you’re really, really sure before you commit. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/8bdf41fcdf520239f90be3fb1b653cc05f3ef33b.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Now your birdhouses can stay full without your bank taking a hit!

See Every Bonus, Big or Small

Ever worn a piece of Inquisitor’s armour and wondered if that tiny 0.5% damage and accuracy boost was really doing anything? Or if your Graceful boots were actually helping with run energy? We’ve fixed that.

The Set Effects menu now shows the bonuses from each individual piece of an outfit, as well as the full set bonus if you’ve got the whole thing equipped. Whether you’re rocking partial Inquisitor’s, Graceful, or one of the many skilling or combat outfits with tiered bonuses, you can now see exactly what each piece is contributing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/64d24da0e9c93a655a9ec9017977540a130a6eb6.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

No more guessing - your stats window now tells the whole story. Equip your gear, check your boosts, and feel smug about every little bonus you earn.

Suggested Worlds Made Clickable

Tired of manually switching worlds for your favourite minigames? Now, on the Grouping tab, the suggested world for each activity is a clickable button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/eeaddebf500162e23829e072284263c0a4612a96.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Click it, confirm the prompt, and you’re in the recommended world without any extra fiddling. Whether you’re heading to Fishing Trawler, Barbarian Assault, or any other activity with a suggested world, hop to it! 
[hr][/hr]
Other Changes
 Fire and Infernal capes will now keep their fiery textures when teleporting, instead of briefly swapping to a static version. Fixed the Slayer cape perk so players can now get back-to-back Zuk tasks as intended. Fixed some blocked ground near Taverley that was stopping players from walking through. The PvP rota has moved to Period A:

World 390 (AUS) for LMS Competitive has been activated with this rota.

World 569 (AUS) for Bounty Hunter has been activated with this rota.

notes.title: Summer Sweep Up Slayer Changes | August 27th
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/461fdf2544960f4bdd99fad54caeb259f0021c38.png
This week’s update continues the Summer Sweep Up, bringing long-awaited improvements to Slayer and Skilling.
[hr][/hr]
Changelog August 27th

[expand type=show more]

Summer Sweep Up Slayer Changes
  Slayer point unlocks have been rebalanced! Slug Salter (80→10), Reptile Freezer (90→10), Ring Bling (300→150), Bigger and Badder (150→50).           Any previously purchased unlocks will be refunded automatically on login.        Each Slayer master now has their own individual block list for tasks.           Blocking a task prevents that specific master from assigning it again, without affecting other Slayer masters.     You'll get a warning if you attempt to block a task that the selected Slayer master does not assign.     Points for previously blocked tasks are automatically refunded upon login.     Shared block lists only apply to Turael, Aya and Spria; all other masters have unique block lists.     The cost of blocking a Slayer task varies by each master: Turael, Aya and Spria→40 pts, Mazchna/Achtryn→50, Vannaka→60, Chaeldar→70, Konar→80, Nieve/Steve→90,        Duradel/Kuradal→100, Krystilia→100.       Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, and Runite dragon tasks are now combined into a single "Metal Dragons" Slayer task, with updated quantities and extensions.           The number of Kill requirements for tasks now starts low (between 30-50 dragons) but can be extended up to 150-200.      Any existing unlocks or extensions for old metal dragons are refunded on login, and your current task will automatically convert to the new Metal Dragons task.        Adjusted the drop rates for Lunar Keys from various PVM encounters in the Twilight Temple dungeon to make obtaining them feel fairer across all combat levels (See main body text for details).  The Rune Pouch can now be purchased from the Mage Training Arena for 150 Telekinetic, 150 Graveyard, 1500 Enchantment, and 200 Alchemist points.         You can only buy one if you don’t already own a Rune Pouch.          Lowered the cost of the Task Storage from slayer rewards from 1000 points → 500. For purchases made previously, 500 points will be refunded upon login.  You can now use Slayer Task Storage for Wilderness Slayer tasks. The Granite hammer now has a 30% Golembane effect, dealing 30% extra damage and accuracy against all golem-type creatures. This includes Gargoyles and covers all phases of the Grotesque Guardians. Selected Slayer creatures that previously dropped 1-2 noted herbs now drop unnoted herbs, allowing for the herb sack to be utilised more effectively.  Helmet of the Moon has been added to the Collection Log and will retroactively unlock for all eligible accounts. Mark of Darkness now lasts 3 minutes by default. Low-level Slayer master points have been buffed! Mazchna now awards 6 points per task (up from 2) and Vannaka 8 points (up from 4).        Milestone multipliers have also been updated to give slightly more points, without surpassing their higher-level masters; Mazchna: 10th task 30 pts, 50th 90 pts; Vannaka: 10th task 40 pts, 50th 120 pts.     
Permanent Deadman Changes
 Added Hespori, Golden Tench, Royal Titans, and Yama uniques to the drop rate multiplier. Unskulled players can now obtain Ancient Crystals from Revenants. 1 Defence accounts can now complete King’s Ransom. A black Wizard Hat, black Priest Gown and black Priest Robe can be worn to bypass the knights in the Black Knights Fortress. Deadman-specific items no longer appear on the main game Grand Exchange. The following changes apply to both Permanent & Tournament Deadman:        Black and Green Dragons in the Wilderness now always drop double dragon bones.    Guarded areas are now properly defended, with wizards freezing skulled intruders for brief periods of time.    Scroll Cases can now be obtained.    Araxxor now awards Slayer XP on task.    
Other Changes
	Slightly lowered the required contribution to receive 100% loot from the Royal Titans. Using other types of damage, such as poison or thralls, should no longer affect obtaining 100% loot quantities.	The Agility requirement for the Castle Draken shortcut has been raised to 86, following player feedback that the previous level was set too low for the benefit offered with this master clue step.	You can now add potions to existing stacks in Potion Storage even if your bank is full. 	Baby blue dragons in the Ruins of Tapoyauik now drop the baby dragon bone required for the Rag and Bone Man II Quest. 	The Arkan blade’s special attack animation now matches between PvP and PvM. 	The 'Guide' option on farming patches now opens the correct section of the Farming skill guide. 	Recent bosses such as Amoxliatl, Araxxor, Whisperer, Leviathan, Vardorvis and others now contribute to the total Boss Kill Count in the Combat Achievements interface. 	Dragon and Zamorak spear special attacks in Castle Wars now use their original shove mechanics, with chain-spearing disabled and no added freeze immunity outside the shove.	Bandages no longer overheal in games of Castlewars on Non-Castlewars themed worlds.	Updated bank action code. Now the "custom" menu entry that is enabled with the auto-charging setting now shows an additional menu, rather than swapping out an existing one.	Fixed a bug where Ent Trunks could continue attacking after their Wilderness Ent was killed with a Twinflame Staff.	Fixed a bug where Challenge Mode Chambers raid layouts could be rerolled by switching leaders or relogging.	Hueycoatl private instances now properly adjust for player counts when participants leave, preventing full instances that would require everyone to leave and start a new instance to continue.	Regent pouch Fixes:					With the bank interface open, the pouch will now automatically show either a "Fill" or "Empty" option depending on your inventory. If you have ingredients that can be stored, it shows "Fill"; if there’s nothing to store, it shows "Empty". This change has also been applied to the Plank Sack.			The pouch now works correctly when making potions at bank chests or other non-standard banks (e.g. Emerald Benedict). Note, you must be standing within a 1 tile radius of the bank to see this effect; step away or close the pouch, and normal rules resume.			Secondary ingredients are now correctly handled when making Weapon Poison (+) and Weapon Poison (++). Previously, potion-making would stop if your inventory ran out of secondary ingredients, even if more were available inside the pouch. Ingredients inside the pouch are now used automatically.			Fixed the slayer master tips on fighting Kree'arra.	Tweaked the examine on the Fossil Island zipline.	Tidied up some misaligned curtains in Player-Owned Houses to better fit the new Canifis and Civitas wall kits. 	"The 'Fill' and 'Check' options on a filled Bottomless Compost Bucket have now been separated, like they are on the empty version. This should make it a little more convenient to use.
PvP Rota

The PvP rota has moved to Period B:
  560 - (UK) - PvP World  319 - (US) - Bounty Hunter World  579 - (US) - High-Risk PvP World  561 - (UK) - Free-to-Play PvP World  580 - (US) - LMS Competitive
World 390 (AUS) for LMS Competitive has been de-activated with this rota.

World 569 (AUS) for Bounty Hunter has been de-activated with this rota.

The PvP Arena is using '1 Def Pure' loadouts in Ranked Duels and Tournaments this week.
[/expand]
[hr][/hr]
Summer Sweep Up Slayer Changes

Summer Sweep Up is here, bringing a wave of skilling and Slayer updates - let’s delve into everything we’ve been tinkering with!

Blocklists: Your Tasks, Your Rules

Ever wanted to tell a Slayer master, "Not today, sir!"? Well, now you can! Each Slayer master now has their own individual block list, putting the power in your hands to avoid those pesky, annoying tasks when you're just not feeling it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/070ec5a44f13d39e1236748af225db60c7955380.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

  Blocking a task from one Slayer master stops that master from giving it to you again - but other masters are still fair game.  Attempting to block a task that the Slayer master doesn’t assign will get you a polite little warning, instead of wasted points.  All your previously blocked tasks? Points are refunded automatically when you log in.  Sharing is caring, but only for Turael, Aya, and Spria. Everyone else gets their own unique lists and block prices:          Turael/Aya and Spria: 40 points      Mazchna/Achtryn: 50 points      Vannaka: 60 points      Chaeldar: 70 points      Konar: 80 points      Nieve/Steve: 90 points      Duradel/Kuradal: 100 points      Krystilia: 100 points        Use the "View List" option on the Slayer Rewards task tab to see the full set of creatures each Slayer Master can assign. Every Master has their own unique list, and from here you can block tasks at the costs listed above.  Green tick - tasks available to block.  Red circle - tasks you’ve already blocked.  Yellow padlock - tasks this Slayer Master cannot assign.  Green padlock - your current task (you therefore cannot get it as a new task, but it's still available to block).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/2575dba889c8efc0ff0a0b69381b81ef163e816b.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Alloyed Adventures with Metal Dragons

Dragon Slayer grind, streamlined! Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, and Runite dragons have been unified under a single "Metal Dragons" task.
	One task to rule them all! Any metal dragon you kill counts toward this task, making it simpler and more flexible.	Tasks now start low (between 30-50 dragons) but can be extended all the way up to 150-200.	Any existing unlocks or extensions for old metal dragons are refunded on login, and your current task will automatically convert to the new Metal Dragons task. 
Simpler, flexible, and still plenty of dragons to slay. Now go forth and smite those metallic foes!

Slayer Unlocks Get a Point Makeover

Ever feel like your Slayer points were vanishing faster than your HP at a Vardorvis rampage? We’ve gone through all the Slayer unlocks and given them a little love. Some of the more basic unlocks were costing way more points than they were worth, so we’ve rebalanced them to make your points go further. 
   Slug Salter - reduced from 80 points → 10 points	Reptile Freezer - reduced from 90 points → 10 points	Ring Bling - reduced from 300 points → 150 points	Bigger and Badder - reduced from 150 points → 50 points
If you’ve already unlocked any of these, don’t worry! You’ll get the appropriate points refunded automatically when you log in, with a nice little message telling you exactly how many points you’ve got back.

Lunar Key Drop Rates Updated

We’ve adjusted the drop rates for Lunar Keys from various PVM encounters in the Twilight Temple dungeon to make obtaining them feel fairer across different combat levels.
  Frost Nagua: 1/1052  Ice Giant: 1/2190  Ice Spider: 1/2036  Chilled Jelly: 1/961  Brutal Blue Dragon: 1/250  Blue Dragon: 1/1216  Baby Blue Dragon: 1/2290  Ice Warrior: 1/2112  Icefiend: 1/3058  Frost Crab: 1/3011  Cave Crawler: 1/2260  Amoxliatl: 1/150 The Hueycoatl: 1/75
We hope these changes improve the lower-end combat scaling, while keeping high-levels challenging and rewarding.

You can now use Slayer Task Storage for Wilderness Slayer tasks.	The Granite hammer now has a 30% Golembane effect, dealing 30% extra damage and accuracy against all golem-type creatures. This includes Gargoyles and covers all phases of the Grotesque Guardians. 	Selected Slayer creatures that previously dropped 1-2 noted herbs now drop unnoted herbs, allowing for the herb sack to be utilised more effectively. Low-level Slayer master points have been buffed! Mazchna now awards 6 points per task (up from 2) and Vannaka 8 points (up from 4).    	   		 Milestone multipliers have also been updated to give slightly more points, without surpassing their higher-level masters; Mazchna: 10th task 30 pts, 50th 90 pts; Vannaka: 10th task 40 pts, 50th 120 pts.    		   
[hr][/hr]
A Date with Doom - Combat Achievements Coming Soon!

We know you’ve all been eagerly awaiting the Dooms Combat Achievements, and the wait is finally over: mark your calendars for September 3rd! Get ready to test your skills and earn your rewards.

Check out the video by clicking here!

notes.title: More Doom Tweaks, Poll 84, & Summer Sweep Up Changes | August 20th
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/6f3c7d5c8d191961903b82b0b96beddf0ccaab71.png
This week’s update brings more Doom boss adjustments, Summer Sweep Up Combat changes, and a bundle of Poll 84 improvements to enhance your adventuring. 
[hr][/hr]
Changelog August 20th

[expand type=show more]

Delve Boss Changes
  The burrow hole will no longer sparkle when a player receives a duplicate pet drop.   Fixed a bug where the Delve boss’s diagonal burrow attack could hit players outside its visible path.  Fixed a bug where rocks placed on acid would disappear when the boss entered its burrow phase.  Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in walls when the burrow hole spawned in a corner.  Projectile attacks immediately following a melee punish will now account for boulder impacts, ensuring that if two projectiles land on the player on the same tick, they will always be of the same damage type. Players can pray to block the damage, but missing the Prayer will result in the full impact of both attacks. If a projectile is travelling towards the boss as it swaps to shield phase, the damage will now still apply to the shield.

This week’s update brings some handy quality-of-life improvements to Farming and Autocasts!

Changelog - April 9th

[expand type=show more]

Farming Improvements
    Gardeners will no longer wander off and will instead remain conveniently stationed at their plots, confined to a 3-tile diameter, ready to assist you.    Leprechauns are now stationed closer to herb patches.    Using a tree seed on a plant pot will now continue planting similar seeds into more pots until you either run out of pots or seeds. Likewise, watering your potted seeds will continue automatically for as long as you have water and unwatered pots of the same type.
Autocast Mishaps
    Autocast is no longer cleared when you don't have the level or runes to cast the selected spell; it will instead remain as your selected auto-cast, and once you regain the runes or level, it will begin casting again.    You can now select a spell to autocast regardless of its level or whether or not you have the runes available.
Poll 83: Castle Wars Tweaks
    To reduce AFK viability and better support active Castle Wars gameplay, Plaudit Crates have been updated and are now re-enabled for purchase and opening. Coins and runes have been removed, and untradeable arrows and bolts (exclusively for use in Castle Wars) have been added.    The message telling you that you cannot attack a teammate in Castle Wars is now filtered.    The Castlewars Rune pouch will now enable free casts of Humidify.    Logging out and back in a game of Castle Wars will no longer magic another rune pouch into your inventory.    The new barricade cap restricting teams to 7 barricades outside and 10 inside the base now only applies on dedicated Castle Wars Worlds.
8 - 16-bit Music Update
    Audio improvements: Transitioned music tracks from 8 -16-bit for improved quality.
Other Changes
   While not many of you are using demonbane spells, there are a handful of places that we suspect people might feel this bugfix impacts them. To compensate, we're reducing the Magic defence of some NPCs	   	 K'ril Tsutsaroth has had his Magic Defence reduced from 130 to 80.     Skotizo has had his Magic Defence reduced from 130 to 80.     Demonic Gorillas have had their Magic Defence reduced from 50 to 20.   	 Cerberus has had her Magic Defence reduced from 100 to 65.	  The recently updated rune pouch menu has been tweaked to let you set a custom quantity as the left-click Store/Withdraw option for runes. Use the 'X' quantity button to customise the quantity and set it as the left-click option on your rune stacks.    As Ironmen can already transfer tradeable items to other characters, we've removed the restriction that stopped them from gifting bonds. They can now 'use' a bond on the recipient to offer it as a free gift, like other characters can.    The collection log is now in the hiscores panel in the sidebar.    Added new "Top-floor" and "Bottom-floor" options to the Ladder at the Grand Tree, Lighthouse, and Lumbridge Castle Staircase for faster navigation.    Fixed an issue where the Ancient Sceptre's bonus to Blood spell healing was being rounded down to zero, preventing the benefit from being applied. The calculation has been updated to ensure the Sceptre now provides its intended bonus.    The inventory icon for the Echo Ahrim's Robe top is no longer clipped, and the icon for the Slayer Ring is more centred in its space.    Fixed a bug where 'Withdraw 5' and 'Withdraw 10' bank options behaved incorrectly when the custom quantity for x was set to 0.    The 'Check' option on the Friendly Zombie Pirate now tells you how many times you've opened the locker, once you've gone through his introductory chat. [hr][/hr]
Farming QoL

We’ve been busy in the garden, making some fresh changes to improve your farming experience!

Gardeners are finally grounded! No more chasing them down - those days are over. Instead, they've been lovingly trapped within a 3-tile diameter, where they’ll remain forever in their tiny, self-made garden prison, waiting eagerly to assist you with your crops. It's like a VIP service... except the VIP is stuck in a tiny square and can't escape. Enjoy the freedom of never losing them again!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/9d6939d5717a66466724e0b21dc43d552b301d3c.jpg
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

That's not all, because the Leprechauns Have Moved In! Leprechauns are now hanging out closer to herb patches, making it quicker and easier to access that sweet, sweet storage. It's like they knew you were coming...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/604acf0ec3c58ee1f40b0d82eaad088a0313375c.jpg
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Finally, planting and watering just got lazy-proofed! You can now use a tree seed on a plant pot and keep planting more similar seeds until you either run out of pots or seeds. No more intense clicking! Also, watering your potted seeds will automatically continue as long as you've got water and unwatered pots of the same type. Now you can water and plant without even thinking about it. 
[hr][/hr]
Autocast Mishaps

Ever been drained by that pesky bat in Inferno, gone to heal up with Blood Barrage, and landed straight into the loving embrace of a Jal-ImKot meleer, sending you straight back to square one? Or maybe you brewed down in TOB, Kodai raised high, only to majestically bonk the aggro crab at Nylo, instead of landing that crucial freeze? 

Well, suffer no more! because autocast just got smarter!

Your autocast will now stick around even if you don’t have the level or runes to cast a spell. Once you regain the requirements, it’ll automatically resume casting - because nothing’s worse than panic-switching to your staff, only to find you’re set to whack instead of zap.
    Select any spell to autocast - even if you lack the level or runes.    Autocast won’t be cleared if you temporarily can’t cast the spell.    Ran out of runes or got drained? Your selected spell will be grayed out until you meet the requirements again.
However, some things haven’t changed:
    Autocast is still cleared when swapping weapons in the Wilderness.    You still can’t cast spells you don’t meet the requirements for - it just won’t wipe your selection anymore.  Autocast is still cleared when using the Spellbook Swap spell. 
What’s in it for you?
    Level 3 accounts can now avoid gaining combat XP by keeping autocast set without accidentally smacking something.    No more tragic misclicks in high-stakes fights - your spell will be ready when you are.
So go forth, cast with confidence, and never fear the accidental staff bonk again!
[hr][/hr]
Poll 83: Castle Wars Tweaks

Plaudits Update

Last week, we introduced Plaudits to the Castle Wars reward shop as a way to offer meaningful rewards for participation. While the goal was to support players who genuinely enjoy the minigame, we quickly saw the unintended consequence: a spike in AFK behavior, with some players prioritising rewards over real gameplay.

We heard your concerns loud and clear and temporarily disabled the crates to reassess. This week, we’re reintroducing them - but with important changes aimed at preserving the integrity of Castle Wars while still offering fair rewards.

What’s Changed?

The revised crates now include some untradeable items that can only be used within Castle Wars matches. This includes the Castle Wars Arrows and Bolts, which have the strength of Dragon Arrows and Dragon Bolts, making them powerful tools for the minigame - but they can’t be traded or used outside of Castle Wars, meaning they won’t impact the wider game economy.

Meanwhile, the rest of the crate contents (like blighted supplies and food) remain usable and tradeable, but we’ve removed high-concern items like Runes and GP, which were previously enabling the crates to serve as a profitable AFK money-maker. These changes are intended to make the crates a lot less attractive for passive farming, and a lot more relevant for active Castle Wars players.

Updated Plaudit Loot (3 Rolls per Crate):
    4 noted Blighted Super Restore Potions    75-105 Castle Wars Arrows (Dragon Arrow strength, untradeable, Castle Wars-only)    75-105 Castle Wars Bolts (Dragon Bolt strength, untradeable, Castle Wars-only)    2 Castle Wars Tickets    10-15 Blighted Ice Sacks    175-225 Rune Arrows    100-120 Rune Javelins    15-25 Blighted Mantas    25-35 Blighted Anglerfish    35-45 Blighted Karambwans    20-30 Blighted Vengeance sacks
We know players have mixed feelings - some would prefer the crates be scrapped entirely, others want the original rewards restored. We hope this middle ground keeps the spirit of Castle Wars alive, offering relevant, balanced rewards without enabling the wrong kind of gameplay.

We’ll keep monitoring how things go, and we’re always open to feedback as we refine things further. Thanks for sticking with us while we work to make Castle Wars the fun, competitive experience it’s meant to be.

In addition, we've also made the following tweaks:
    The message telling you that you cannot attack a teammate in Castle Wars is now filtered.    The Castlewars Rune pouch will now enable free casts of Humidify.    Logging out and back in a game of Castle Wars will no longer magic another rune pouch into your inventory.    The new barricade cap restricting teams to 7 barricades outside and 10 inside the base now only applies on dedicated Castle Wars Worlds. 
Now back to storming castles and setting things on fire as usual!
[hr][/hr]
8 - 16 Bit Music Update

We wanted to give you an update on some audio improvements we're making to Old School RuneScape.

We were thrilled by the positive response and the genuine enthusiasm you showed for the audio team's efforts in our recent 16-bit blog post. If you missed that, you can check it out here and get the full lowdown.

However, we also heard your concerns about preserving the authentic Old School feel that you know and love.

We understand completely!

Rest assured, maintaining that classic Old School RuneScape vibe is our absolute priority. We're not looking to reinvent the wheel, but rather to polish it, ensuring your auditory experience keeps pace with the game's evolution. Today, we want to dive a little deeper into the musical side of this upgrade, specifically addressing the transition from 8-bit to 16-bit music.

Recently, we've been working on transitioning our music tracks from 8-bit to a more versatile 16-bit format. You might have also noticed a very subtle layer of white noise in some of the music tracks, which this update will smooth out.

What to Expect

In most cases, the change will be minimal, or not even noticeable.  The Old School feel of the music you love will remain unchanged. We're rolling out this update for music tracks first. We're holding off on sound effects for the time being, as we want to further refine and improve those before any updates are made.

Why the Change?

This is about a gentle refinement, not a dramatic overhaul. The 16-bit format allows for a cleaner, more versatile OSRS sound. This, in turn, will help us maintain audio quality and lay the important groundwork for any future audio improvements. Go ahead, take a listen, and let us know what you think:

Check out the video  here!

Harmony

Check out the video  here!

Rose

This section will assume that you're up-to-date with Yama, so if you need a refresher then make sure to check out the dedicated blog by clicking here.

The core encounter (meaning without any Contracts applied) is more or less finished, so we've invited a handful of players to test what we've got so far. If those playtests go well, we'll be able to lock in a release date and share it with you ASAP so that you can book time off work, stock up on snacks, move to a quiet place in the countryside free from distractions - whatever it is you've got to do to satisfy your PvM itch.

Here's how the default appearance looks, we took the original proposal for the more prestigious look and ran with it, but made an even cooler look for the 'flex cosmetic' variant...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/6d90c9107928b8fe3aa24e313b5a479bb7c1f105.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Here's what you can expect to see the best of the best rocking! It's a pretty unique colour scheme that really makes this Oathplate variant stand out, but still pairs nicely with a lot of other best-in-slot options!

Eagle-eyed readers will undoubtedly have noticed that we're still calling it Oathplate armour, despite some feedback that 'Oathplate platebody' was a bit of a mouthful and a popular suggestion for the set to be called 'Oathbreaker armour' instead. Narratively, we weren't too keen on 'Oathbreaker' because no oaths have been broken - and we wouldn't recommend looking for any loopholes with Yama either. Some players suggested using words like hauberk or cuisse for the armour pieces, but these don't really match up to the appearance since they're very specific terms. For now, we're sticking with the Oathplate helm, Oathplate chest and Oathplate legs - no 'platebody' needed because the clue's in the name!

Beyond Yama itself, we've made great progress on the Chasm of Fire skilling activities! Take a look...

Check out the video here!

The video above should give you a look at what you'll find yourself doing if you're looking to earn some GP by skilling or make a piece of Oathplate armour for yourself using armour shards. One player can be seen mining some Infernal shale at a large vein, this is a super laid-back approach that's very low intensity but doesn't yield a high output. Next to them, you can see somebody mining considerably more actively and wiping the sweat from their brow, but there's not a pestle and mortar in sight - we'll leave you to speculate on this one for now, just know that you've got a variety of options for gathering up your Infernal shale.

In the background you can see another player who's all done with mining and starting to smith their Oathplate bars, timing their actions perfectly to smelt and quench at lightning speed. Not shown here is the final step: smithing! While we didn't have enough hands to show it off here, you'll have a neat timing-based Smithing activity to speed up your time on the anvil.

All-in-all, the skilling activities give you a bunch of options for intensity that let you get out what you put in and while they're not exactly 'universal' methods, we think they're a lot of fun and hope you'll enjoy them for yourself on Yama's release, even if you're not looking to take on the formidable demon himself!

That's all we've got to share for now, we're excited to see how our playtesters do this week and to get a release date in front of you as soon as possible, so keep an eye out!
[hr][/hr]
The Great OSRS Eggstravaganza Competition

With Easter just around the corner, we're getting in the mood with a cracking new community competition! Prepare your brushes, markers, and questionable artistic skills - it’s time for the OSRS-themed Egg Decorating Competition!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/3fb748239d3852980b6723478d122bd72d6af1aa.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

We want to see your best (or worst) attempts at turning an egg into a masterpiece worthy of the Evil chicken! Whether you're working with chocolate eggs, plastic eggs, or a good ol' fashioned fridge egg that definitely wasn’t meant for this - get creative and bring Gielinor to life, egg style!

How to Enter

    Snag an egg-like object    Decorate it with an OSRS theme - whether it’s an iconic NPC, a legendary weapon, or just a very cursed attempt at a Potato Cactus.    Snap a pic and submit it in either the #egg-competition channel on the official OSRS Discord or in the egg competition post on the r/2007scape subreddit.
When?

    Competition Opens: Monday, April 7th 10:00AM BST    Competition Closes: Monday, April 14th 10:00 AM BST    Winner Selection: Our judge will narrow the competition down to two finalists per category, but the ultimate champions will be decided LIVE by Twitch chat during our Easter Livestream on April 17th, 16:00 - 17:00 BST
Competition Categories

	Funniest Egg - The one that cracks us up the most!	Most Creative Egg - The most uneggxpected, out-of-the-box/coop design!	Most OSRS-Inspired Egg – The one that best embodies the soul of Gielinor!
The Prizes

Winners of each category will score themselves 10 Old School Bonds and 3 months of membership, to help keep that gaming on track.

So, grab your paints, markers, or whatever questionable decoration supplies you may have lying around, and get cracking! We can't wait to see the absolute masterpieces (or eggs-traordinarily disturbed) pieces you hatch up!

In-game Easter Eggs

We're also hosting an Easter-trivia channel in the Discord for you to share and discover hidden Easter eggs across Gielinor! We’re talking about those sneaky little details, quirky mechanics, and fun secrets that only the most dedicated adventurers have uncovered.

Think you know an obscure OSRS Easter egg? Drop it here! 

Need inspiration? Ever tossed a gold ring into the Wilderness Volcano? You might just be in for a surprise… We'll be featuring some of the best trivia during our Easter Livestream on April 17th (16:00), so share your best finds, and you might get a shoutout!


Let the egg-streme creativity begin!

Rules of RuneScape Wording Update

This one's not strictly related to this week's Game Update, but we wanted to make sure you were in the loop!

We've updated the wording on our Rules of RuneScape page so that it matches up with our T&Cs, specifically to the wording around Real World Trading. The following paragraph has been updated:

"Real World trading (RWT) means buying or selling in the real world, for real money or in exchange for anything of value, things that relate to Jagex accounts."

In plain terms, this adjustment is to make clear in the rules (though it was already clear in the T&Cs) that RWT does not need to involve real money and pertains to 'anything of value'. This should make it clearer that performing out-of-game services like using your Twitch channel or Discord server to advertise other Twitch channels or Discord servers in exchange for GP is categorically RWT, as is paying for these services in this manner.
[hr][/hr]
Other Changes

Before we get into the usual bullet point list, we've got one change this week that we'd like to expand on a little.

While playtesting Yama internally, we noticed some unusually high accuracy rolls with Demonbane spells. Turns out that since release, the Purging Staff + Demonbane spells have been more accurate than intended. With this week's game update, we're fixing a bug where Demonbane spells were multiplying accuracy incorrectly with the bonuses from Purging Staff and Mark of Darkness.

While not many of you are using demonbane spells, there are a handful of places that we suspect people might feel this bugfix impacts them. To compensate, we're reducing the Magic defence of some NPCs - we suspect that with these changes, you likely won't notice any difference, but we'll be keeping an eye out for feedback! Keep in mind that Tormented Demons aren't really relevant here owing to their shield mechanic and granting 100% accuracy, so if you're wondering why they're not on the list then you've got your answer.
    K'ril Tsutsaroth has had his Magic Defence reduced from 130 to 80.    Skotizo has had his Magic Defence reduced from 130 to 80.    Demonic Gorillas have had their Magic Defence reduced from 50 to 20.    Cerberus has had her Magic Defence reduced from 100 to 65.
Now, bring on the miscellaneous changes!

Use the 'X' quantity button to customise the quantity and set it as the left-click option on your rune stacks.    As Ironmen can already transfer tradeable items to other characters, we've removed the restriction that stopped them from gifting bonds. They can now 'use' a bond on the recipient to offer it as a free gift, like other characters can.    The collection log is now in the hiscores panel in the sidebar.    Added new "Top-floor" and "Bottom-floor" options to the Ladder at the Grand Tree, Lighthouse, and Lumbridge Castle Staircase for faster navigation.    Fixed an issue where the Ancient Sceptre's bonus to Blood spell healing was being rounded down to zero, preventing the benefit from being applied. The calculation has been updated to ensure the Sceptre now provides its intended bonus.    The inventory icon for the Echo Ahrim's Robe top is no longer clipped, and the icon for the Slayer Ring is more centred in its space.    Fixed a bug where 'Withdraw 5' and 'Withdraw 10' bank options behaved incorrectly when the custom quantity for x was set to 0.    The 'Check' option on the Friendly Zombie Pirate now tells you how many times you've opened the locker, once you've gone through his introductory chat. Poll 83: Castle Wars Update 

Dedicated Castle Wars world changes:

On members worlds, players are now granted Plaudits alongside tickets. These Plaudits can be used to purchase Castle Wars supply crates via Lanthus.
All Castle Wars world changes:
    The Castlewars brew now also applies the effects of a Stamina Potion and Super restore when consumed. Note: The reduction in run energy depletion associated with Stamina potions won't occur on F2P worlds.    Helmets can now be worn in Castle Wars, enabling the use of armour set effects.    Bandages now scale with your Hitpoints level and can overheal, similar to Anglerfish.    Castle Wars bracelets can now be handed to Lanthus to store charges, automatically consuming one per game.     You can now use blighted food and cast Vengeance with blighted sacks while in the Castle Wars lobby.    Players now receive a Rune Pouch when entering Castle Wars, providing unlimited runes for select spells. Note, these spells no longer grant casting XP when the pouch is used, but still award XP based on damage dealt. To earn full Magic XP, you will need to drop the pouch and bring your own runes. Placed barricades now have a coloured rope to indicate what team they belong to.    Barricades can now be placed in front of the respawn barriers.     A new element has been added to the Castle Wars Heads-Up Display, showing the number of barricades your team has placed both inside and outside your base.    Small walls have been added to the stairs and ladder at the respawn point, allowing players to range over them and create more strategic barricade placements.    On non-Castle Wars worlds, players within Castle Wars will be able to shove targets back-to-back using the Dragon Spear and Zamorakian Hasta special attacks. On Castle Wars Worlds, players will still be unable to perform consecutive shoves on the same target.    There is now a table with buckets in the supply room where the bucket spawn used to be. Poll 83: Castle Wars Update

Castle Wars Brews

Raise your vials, because Castlewars brews just got a double shot of power! Now, when you down a brew, you'll not only get the usual combat kick, but also the effects of a Stamina Potion and Super Restore too! That means more energy to sprint into battle and a quicker recovery to keep you in the fight. 

Helmets On

Hood holding you back? No more! Players can now wear helmets in Castle Wars, unlocking all those coveted armour set effects – whether you're sporting Torva or rocking that Void, now you can look sharp and fight even sharper! 

Bandages That Mean Business

No more half-hearted healing! Bandages in Castle Wars now scale with your Hitpoints level and can overheal, just like Anglerfish. That extra bit of health could be the difference between a quick retreat and a triumphant comeback. Slap on those bandages and charge back to the fray with confidence!

Portal Changes

If you love the color green, then get ready to celebrate because Guthix is taking over! Castle Wars has always been a blast, but those one-sided games? Not so much. We’ve borrowed a little magic from Soul Wars to bring back the balance. 

Now, on dedicated Castle Wars worlds, you’ll be entering only through the Guthix portal, ensuring that teams are more evenly matched. No more Saradomin and Zamorak portals causing team stacking! We’re putting a stop to those unfair sides once and for all.

Prefer your games the old way? No worries! If you're playing on a regular world, you can still waltz through any portal and pick your side. No green pressure there.

We hope these changes will make every match more competitive, more exciting, and more fun. So grab your Ancients, rally your team, and get ready to battle - this time, it’s going to be a fair fight!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/494b342204c67edb57ea76d13d4831587d7194fb.jpg

If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Castlewars Bracelets

Bracelets in Castle Wars - they're great for those sweet buffs, but let's face it, they often get tossed aside at the start of the game. Well, worry no more - Lanthas has got your back and is here to save the day (and your bracelets)!

With this update, you can now store bracelet charges with Lanthas, keeping them safe for future battles without the hassle. You can even store noted versions! At the start of each game, one charge will automatically be used, and if you're not feeling it, this feature can be toggled on or off.

Lanthas won’t just take your bracelets and run, though - a confirmation prompt ensures you don’t accidentally deposit more than intended. If you’ve got a handful of bracelets, the Deposit-X option lets you store multiple at once.

Castle Wars Rune Pouch Update

Ready to cast spells without the headache of remembering your runes? Introducing the Rune Pouch to Castle Wars! 

When you jump into a Castle Wars game, you’ll be handed a temporary Rune Pouch loaded with all the runes you need to cast your favorite spells. Forget about worrying if you packed the right runes - just hop in and start casting! Here’s the catch though: This pouch won’t earn you any cast XP for spellcasting, but you will still get XP for dealing damage! To earn full Magic XP, you will need to drop the pouch and bring your own runes.

Dropped your pouch or accidentally lost it in the heat of battle? No worries! You can grab another one from the table in your team’s spawn area. For those who prefer their own runes, just ditch the Rune Pouch, and you’ll be back to casting with full XP rewards. If you’ve got both personal runes and the pouch, don’t sweat it – the pouch will take priority when casting, so you won’t end up wasting your personal stash.

What Spells Can Be Used?

The Rune Pouch opens up a world of combat and utility spells across the Standard, Ancient, Lunar, and Arceuus spellbooks. Here’s a breakdown of the spells you can cast, depending on your chosen spellbook:
    Standard Spells: Wind Strike, Bind, Snare, Entangle, Saradomin Strike, Claws of Guthix, Flames of Zamorak, and more.    Ancient Magicks: Blood Barrage, Ice Barrage, Smoke Burst, and other PvP-relevant spells.    Lunar Spells: Vengeance, Spellbook Swap, and Energy Transfer.    Arceuus Spells: Ghostly Grasp, Vile Vigour, and Ward of Arceuus.
Also to note:
    Spells requiring a staff (e.g., Saradomin Strike, Claws of Guthix) will still require the appropriate staff to cast.    Non-PvP utility spells like High Alchemy and Enchanting remain restricted.
We hope this change lets you dive into Castle Wars without the hassle of packing your own runes, so you can get straight to the action, while still respecting the grind and integrity of your standard magic training methods. 

More Tickets, More Loot!

Who doesn’t love a little extra loot? On dedicated Castle Wars worlds, we're boosting your rewards with an additional ticket just for participating. Here’s the new, shiny reward structure:

Dedicated Castle Wars worlds:
    No points draw → 2 tickets each    Draw with points → 3 tickets each    Win (both teams scored points) → 3 for winners, 2 for losers    Win (no lost flags) → 4 for winners, 2 for losers
Non-Castle Wars worlds:
    No points draw → 1 ticket each    Draw with points → 2 tickets each    Win (both teams scored points) → 2 for winners, 1 for losers    Win (no lost flags) → 3 for winners, 1 for losers
On dedicated Castle Wars worlds, members will now earn Plaudits alongside tickets. These Plaudits can be exchanged with Lanthus for Castle Wars supply crates. Lanthus's store has been revamped with a sleek new interface, but don't worry - the classic rewards are still available at their original prices.

Now, on members worlds, you can also trade a Plaudit for a supply crate. This crate requires two additional inventory spaces to open and contains:​
    Blighted potions and food​    A mixture of Blood, Death, Soul, and Nature runes​​    Rune arrows and Javelins​​​​    Lovely Money!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/588683f2d9cad93c4e9b815a8361830356925434.jpg

Selecting "All" will set it as the default left-click for both actions - so no more right-clicking and hunting for that one pesky option! Plus, your last selection is saved even after logging out, so you won’t have to set it again every time you play.

Changelog - March 26th

[expand type=show more]

Poll 83 Changes
  Updated the Slayer Cape perk when used at Konar to reassign tasks within the same area. The perk now considers the specific location of the task when offering a repeat assignment.  You can now cast Alchemy by using items on the Explorer’s Ring, removing the need to wear it or navigate a dialogue box.  Added a new dialogue option to receive another farming contract at the same tier as the one a player has just completed.  You can now mouse over any fairy ring you have unlocked on the world map to be reminded of its code.  Added a seed pack reward to Tithe Farm in exchange for points.  Prayer tooltips now shows the base drain rates of all prayers.  Updated the Shades of Morton's chest designs with clearer markings on top, making them more distinguishable.  ​Mazchna, Vannaka, and Chaeldar now assign Slayer tasks to hunt Crabs. This includes Ammonite, Frost, Rock, Sand and Swamp crabs.  All skill guides now feature a new tab named after the skill, providing an overview of what the skill is and the benefits of levelling it.  Your game settings will now be automatically adjusted based on your choice when asked on Tutorial Island whether you’re a Beginner, Returning, or Experienced player.
Player Support Update
  From today onwards, whenever your macroing (botting) report has been reviewed and actioned, you'll receive an inbox message directly in your Message Centre.
Emote Looping Continued
  The emote looping feature has been added to an additional 45 emotes. This also includes looping for specific treasure trail items such as Flared trousers, Sleeping cap, Powdered wig and Pantaloons.
W345 Permanent Deadman Changes
  Increased the rarity of Charms and stopped players with Deadman protection from obtaining them. This is to help the prices of the items long term and reward players taking those risks with extra loot!  Removed the Elite Diary requirement for purchasing Elite Void. Now you can simply take a regular Void Knight Top or Void Knight Robes to the Elite Void Knight at Pest Control and upgrade your regular void pieces to Elite void pieces for 200 points per piece!   Added an option to change the respawn location to the Grand Exchange. Talk to Brugsen Bursen at the Grand Exchange to choose your respawn point upon death, similar to Deadman Armageddon.  All players can now use Chivalry, Rigour, and Augury in Permanent Deadman Mode provided they have the prayer level requirement, regardless of their defence level. Chivalry still requires the completion of the Holy Grail quest, Rigour and Augury still requires the prayer scrolls.  Trinkets now turn to Trinket dust upon death, similar to Charms.   The old Deadman skulls (as seen in Bounty Hunter) have returned to Permanent Deadman.   A check has been added to prevent skulled players from diving with the rowboat on Fossil Island.

Aggie in Draynor Village has been updated with a Make-All interface for her red, yellow and blue dyes. Fixed an issue where getting hit by another player's 'Duel' operation while using Mystic Cards would cause Emote 'Loop' options to stop working until the player moved tiles.  The Alchemist's Amulet can no longer be purchased when the player has no space in their inventory.  Fixed an issue where quickly destroying the Orb of Oculus while activating the Scry function could crash the client. Poll 83 QoL Changes

This week, we’re rolling out some of the QoL Poll 83 changes you’ve been waiting for - with even more coming next week! Below is a rundown of the latest updates we've implemented, many of which were inspired by your feedback. So, grab a cuppa and let's dive in!

Slaying Crabs

Shellfish enthusiasts get ready - our community’s favourite low-effort combat training method is now part of Slayer tasks! That’s right, the crab has scuttled its way onto the task lists for Mazchna, Vannaka, and Chaeldar. These tough-shelled training partners have long been a go-to for efficient combat experience, and this update should help newer players discover their benefits too.

If you receive a Crabs task, you can take on any of the following:
  Ammonite Crabs: Located on Fossil Island and within the Wyvern Cave.​  Frost Crabs: Found amidst the Ruins of Tapoyauik.​  Rock Crabs: Reside north of Rellekka, on Waterbirth Island, west of Mount Quidamortem, inside the Waterbirth Island Dungeon, and within the Brine Rat Cavern.​  Sand Crabs: Can be encountered on the Isle of Souls, Crabclaw Isle, east of the Hosidius Vinery, south of the Colossal Wyrm Agility Course, and along the coast south of the Fortis Coliseum.​  Swamp Crabs: Dwell in the swamp north of Darkmeyer and to the east of Slepe.
Slayer Cape Perk at Konar

Your Slayer Cape has had a bit of a tune-up. Now, when its perk is triggered at Konar, it will reassign the task within the same area by considering the exact location of your current assignment. No more rerolls that leave you scratching your head – you’ll get the same monster and same location to keep that Slaying momentum going!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/3880c5498d6050e99a9a652cf4c8ceb2cb8c41f0.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Explorer’s Ring Alchemy

Who has time to navigate clunky dialogue boxes mid-battle? Not you! The Explorer’s Ring now lets you cast Alchemy simply by using items on it. This little tweak means you can transform your loot in a flash, freeing up inventory space for more treasures. 

Farming Contracts

We all know Guildmaster Jane loves a good chat - but sometimes, you just want to get back to farming! That’s why we’ve added a new dialogue option that lets you grab another contract of the same tier instantly after finishing one. Less menu navigation, more time planting - your green thumb will thank you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/9deeeadba16e654d74ea1ac30d5785e9ae04b59a.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Fairy Rings on the Map

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/e0f9a50aa891195bda715a3031e075740ff4e01e.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Ever forgotten a fairy ring code mid-route? We’ve all been there. Now, when you mouse over any fairy ring you’ve unlocked on the world map, its code will pop up. Neat!

Tithe Farm Reward – Seed Packs!

Your efforts at Tithe Farm just got a little sweeter! The Tithe Farm shop has been upgraded to use the new shop interface - don’t worry, you can still grab all the same rewards as before. Plus, we’ve added a brand-new seed pack reward, available for purchase with Tithe Points! This isn’t just any seed pack; it’s equivalent to a Tier 3 Farming Guild contract reward, with a dash of chance at a White Lily Seed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/b2e9193ca71fa5fbd19c6b08fab4af00c4fac3aa.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Personalised Settings for New Accounts

New to Gielinor? No problem! When you step onto Tutorial Island, you’ll be asked if you’re a Beginner, Returning, or Experienced player. Based on your answer, your settings will automatically adjust to suit your style:
  Beginners: Enjoy a fresh guide interface with enhanced skill descriptions – say goodbye to overwhelming menus and hello to easy learning!  Returning Players: Your tried-and-true settings remain just as you left them, ready for another round of adventure.  Experienced Players enjoy optimised defaults, such as:        Roof hiding for a clearer view    Shift-click to drop items    Refined attack options (right-click on players, left-click on NPCs),    Make-X for darts and bolts disabled     Collection log new addition popup and notification enabled    Enabled precise timing    PK Skull Prevention    Auto-equip worn items from gravestones    Rune-picking behaviour     Drop item warning disabled    Casting Alchemy Spells on Untradeable items warning disabled     The minimum item value needed for Alchemy spells warning is set to 0     All "Plank make X confirmation" options disabled    Accept Aid is disabled    
This change cuts down the time spent tweaking settings, letting you jump straight into your adventures.

Shades of Morton chests

We’ve given Shades of Morton’s chests a makeover – now sporting clearer top markings so you can easily spot those secret loot stashes. This upgrade is especially handy for mobile players who know that spotting a chest shouldn’t feel like a scavenger hunt!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/8b0ab8a9385d78646be8f9022a460cc6458445dc.png
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Prayer Tooltips

Ever wondered how much juice your prayers are really draining? Well, wonder no more! Prayer tooltips now display the base drain rates for all prayers, giving you that extra bit of insight during those heated battles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/d5016fe3a65d34a11d118ec9faca83c9380bcb6d.jpg
If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Skill Guide Summaries

Finally, we’ve improved our skill guides with a brand new tab for each skill. These summaries break down what each skill does and the benefits of levelling them up. Whether you’re a battle-hardened veteran or just starting out, this extra clarity will help you plan your path to glory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/8d764eac31204e63f9643839c8ec19c1eef99e18.jpg
If you can’t see the image above, click here!
[hr][/hr]
Player Support Update

Back in December, we shared a Player Support Survey: 'Help Shape the Future' to better understand what areas of our support offering you want to see improved. Your feedback was clear, with 89% of you saying you'd value receiving confirmation when your cheating reports lead to action.

We've got good news! We've delivered the first step of this improvement ahead of schedule! Rather than waiting until our full Player Support Improvements Roadmap reveal next month, we decided there's no reason to delay something that’s ready today.

From today onwards, whenever your macroing (botting) report has been reviewed and actioned, you'll receive an inbox message directly in your Message Centre. This is an initial rollout for macroing reports, and we'll be closely monitoring feedback as we look to expand this system to cover additional types of cheating reports in future.

This improvement is part of our ongoing commitment to making the world of Gielinor fairer, safer, and more enjoyable for everyone.

If you missed the recent Q&A with Mod North, you'll be pleased to know there’s even more to come! We’ll be sharing the full Player Support Improvements Roadmap in April, detailing further upgrades to your support experience across 2025.

Got questions? We’ve put together an FAQ here!
[hr][/hr]
More Emote Looping!

Hold onto your Sleeping caps, adventurers - your favourite emotes are now on an endless loop! We’ve added 45 looping emote sequences to ensure every move you make is the envy of Gielinor. If you’re sporting Treasure Trails gear like the Flared Trousers, Sleeping Cap, Powdered Wig, or Pantaloons, your enhanced emotes now loop with extra swagger - it’s your very own runway moment!

If you can’t see the image above, click here!

Merch Update

New Youtooz Plushies - Coming Soon!

General Graardor and Sandwich Lady plushies drop on Youtooz March 28th – mark your diaries now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/74ce0be1a440e5cf058d3237fa40f186fab978ec.png

Don't forget you only have a few days left to get your hands on the WOM and Gnome child figures - pre-orders have been extended to March 28th at 3pm EST on Youtooz - get them whilst you can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/c6c891d26ef2a83579f9693de7ee2dac225931fc.png

RF25 Merch - Last Chance

Pre-orders close on March 31st for RF25 attendee exclusive lines - the RF25 Hoodie, Tee and Skillchip Box - order them now here if you missed out at the event!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39707052/a379bf651bc0e42efb4b3ee81d1d25eb73f908f5.jpg

Pre-orders also close on 31st March for this commemorative 10th RF Tee - open to anyone to order who wants to celebrate past RuneFests! Check out this and the full range of merch here.

W345 Permanent Deadman Changes

  Increased the rarity of Charms and stopped players with Deadman protection from obtaining them. This is to help the prices of the items long term and reward players taking those risks with extra loot!  Removed the Elite Diary requirement for purchasing Elite Void. Now you can simply take a regular Void Knight Top or Void Knight Robes to the Elite Void Knight at Pest Control and upgrade your regular void pieces to Elite void pieces for 200 points per piece!   Added an option to change the respawn location to the Grand Exchange. Talk to Brugsen Bursen at the Grand Exchange to choose your respawn point upon death, similar to Deadman Armageddon.  All players can now use Chivalry, Rigour, and Augury in Permanent Deadman Mode provided they have the prayer level requirement, regardless of their defence level. Chivalry still requires the completion of the Holy Grail quest, Rigour and Augury still requires the prayer scrolls.  Trinkets now turn to Trinket dust upon death, similar to Charms.   The old Deadman skulls (as seen in Bounty Hunter) have returned to Permanent Deadman.   A check has been added to prevent skulled players from diving with the rowboat on Fossil Island.

  Logging out whilst in the Theatre of Blood or Tombs of Amascut while you have an Escape Crystal in your inventory will now consume the crystal and teleport you outside of the raid on login, preserving any HCIM status you might have.  Aggie in Draynor Village has been updated with a Make-All interface for her red, yellow and blue dyes. Instead of crafting dyes one at a time through dialogue, you can now quickly select how many you’d like to make in one go.  Lore books in Chambers and TOB will no longer drop once a player has read them.  Fixed an issue where getting hit by another player's 'Duel' operation while using Mystic Cards would cause Emote 'Loop' options to stop working until the player moved tiles.  The Alchemist's Amulet can no longer be purchased when the player has no space in their inventory.  Fixed an issue where quickly destroying the Orb of Oculus while activating the Scry function could crash the client.

Apologies for the delay in sharing yesterday’s Game Update newspost here, and thanks for your patience! This update brought Bounty Hunter changes alongside improvements to Collection Logs and emotes.

Changelog January 29th

[expand type=show more]

Bounty Hunter Changes
  Made stat changes to items obtained from and useable only within Bounty Hunter to improve balance and build variety.  Adjusted the charge costs for specific items: Vesta’s Spear (5 Million), Statius’s Warhammer (10 Million), Morrigan's Throwing Axe (5 Million), Morrigan's Javelin (10 Million), and Zuriel's Staff (5 Million).  Removed the ability to bring Phoenix Necklaces into Daimon's Crater.  Doubled EP gain rate for players with a minimum of 50,000 risk and active targets.   Risk tiers now display coloured skulls based on the amount of GP risked, ranging from Bronze (8 Million).  Players can pre-pack two supply crates in the lobby to bring with them to Daimon's Crater.

  Streamlined the overview interface.          The overview now includes your 12 most recently obtained items and a new ranking system - progression ranks from Bronze (100 collections) to Gilded (% based, but around 1400 collections currently).      Head to The Collector in Varrock Museum to claim your Staff of Collection (Ranging from Bronze to Gilded). Right-click the staff to create the accompanying Book.   Ironmen accounts (not GIM) can now retroactively log certain whitelisted items obtained before December 2018. This will only include tradeable items that were on the Log from launch.  Compete with others on the new Collection Log HiScores!

  Perform emotes by typing "::anyemote" or "!anyemote" in the chat box. For example: !cheer or ::cheer.  Right-click and select 'Loop emote' to perform certain animations (currently Dance, Jig, Headbang, Fortis Salute, and Sit Down) continuously.   Added a new Sit emote.

Other Changes
  The Raging Echoes Rug can now be built in the League Hall.   Players can now create Chromium Ingots after discovering the secret of Chromium Smithing in the Undercity of Lassar.  Fixed typos on the Max Cape teleport.  Fixed a visual issue with Skotizo's magic attack.  It is now possible to click completed Combat Achievement tasks in the chat box to see their description.  World hopping should no longer produce an abnormal amount of Forestry events.  Increased the rate (50-150s →  40-120s) and radius (20 tiles → 30 tiles) of player eligibility for Forestry events.  The new Deposit Lock buttons can now be right-clicked to toggle the locks off and on again more conveniently.

  560 - (UK) - PvP World  319 - (US) - Bounty Hunter World  579 - (US) - High-Risk PvP World  561 - (UK) - Free-to-Play PvP World  580 - (US) - LMS Competitive
